integration_analysis.data_source: Dashboard worksheet at configured index 0, getSummaryDataAsync includeAllColumns/ignoreSelection/ignoreAliases
integration_analysis.x_filter_initialization: The extension clears the configured x-axis filter during initialization before fetching its base overview data.
integration_analysis.duplicate_month_aggregation: Code increments property priceee for later rows of the same month, while the draw handler uses the configured y-axis field directly. Thus the first borough value is retained, rather than the sum of five boroughs.
integration_analysis.source_scope: Observed source overview is preserved as real extension behavior. It does not serve as all-borough numeric acceptance evidence.
integration_analysis.brushing_contract: D3 brushX end event maps selected extent to the configured worksheet date filter; actual browser drag execution is not asserted.
